chapter: Chicago, Detroit and Seattle Harmony Kings
title: A gunman shoots out the spotlight at Fogarty's club
summary: A man at a reserved table shoots out the stage lights during the floor show; the band flees but the customers stay.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: You do the very same thing today. But, I remember, it was a kind of a place where it was owned and run-undoubtedly Capone --owned that spot--- and he had this guy Fogarty who was the manager who ran the place. And, I could remember such terrifying things as one Saturday night when we were ready for the floor show -- and the place was packed -- there was only one table that said "reserved" on it; some guy staggered in and sat in at that table and when they tried to get him out he pulled out his gun and shot the show lights out. You know, the spotlight--- he must have been a hell of a shot --- and I want to tell you, from the time that first shot went off, there was no band within three weeks of that place--- oh, man, did we get lost---and, so, they finally got him out of there and we went on with the show. And, I think, the funniest thing of all, how frightening that all was -- nobody left---
No - none of the customers left---
The band is the only thing that got out of there in a hurry - because he was shooting the spotlights
